text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Executive Order No. 79, dated December 17, 1945, as
amended by Executive Order No. 12, dated August 19, 1946,
Executive Order No. 137, dated May 7, 1948, and Exe-
cutive Order No. 164, dated August 12, 1948, is hereby
further amended to read as follows:
"By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, Elpidio Quirino,
President of the Philippines, do hereby create and constitute a
Quezon Memorial Committee which shall be composed of the follow-
The Hororable, the Secretary of the Interior Chairman
Hon. Jose Yelo
Hon. Tomas B. Morato
The Honorable, the Secretary of Finance ..........
'The Honorable, the Secretary of Education
The Honorable, the Secretary of Labor ...............
Vice-Chairman
Vice-Chairman
The President, Philippine Amateur Athletic
Federation
The President, Philippine Chamber of Commerce Member
The President, Confederation of Women's Clubs Member
'The Treasurer of the Philippines
Mr. Antonio Rivero .....
The Committee shall take charge of the nation-wide campaign
to raise funds for the erection of a memorial foundation in honor
of the late President Manuel L. Quezon, as well as the selection
of the most suitable site on which to erect the same. The Quezon
Memorial Committee is hereby authorized to appoint and organize
as many sub-committees as may be necessary in the provinces,
municipalities, and chartered cities, and to promulgate rules and
regulations to carry out the work entrusted to it. The Committee
shall meet at such times and places as may be designated by the
Chairman and shall submit its report to the President from time
"All funds coming into the Treasury of the Quezor. Memorial
Committee shall be deposited with the Philippine National Bank
or with any other banking institution authorized to do business
in tne Philippines and the necessary withdrawals therefrom shall
be made only by checks duly signed by the Treasurer of the Com-
mittee and countersigned by the Chairman and by the auditor to
be designated by the Auditor General.
"All books of account kept in connection with the campaign shall
always be made available for audit by the authorized representative
of the Auditor Genera!."
Done in the City of Baguio, this 20th day of April, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1637
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
